description: Central political focus on the expansion of renewable electricity, especially solar power. As president of Swissolar and a member of the National Council's economic affairs committee, Grossen advocates accelerating the build-out of solar and other renewables.

Promotion of electric mobility, charging infrastructure and the removal of barriers to electric-vehicle adoption; president of the Swiss eMobility association and active in the parliamentary intergroup on electromobility.
Advocates climate-protection measures and has argued that the expansion of renewables will diminish the importance of nuclear power; supporter of ending nuclear power in Switzerland.
Champions a liberal economic order aligned with environmental protection, emphasising competition, innovation and an open, connected Switzerland.

Interest in smart-grid technology, intelligent buildings and digitalisation of the construction sector, reflected in his company Smart Energy Link and ties to Bauen digital Schweiz and SmartGridready.
Supporter of marriage equality ("Marriage for All") and socially liberal positions.
